messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 - GPU pool saturating in eu-west-1. Observed sustained queue growth on redwood-prod-gpu-pool-3, autoscaler hitting max_scale_limit. Alert: high queue depth + token latency spike. Paging eve-oncall. https://incidents.redwood/internal/4987654320

eve-oncall: ack - I'm on it. grabbing logs and ta[31mpriority console[0m. Please post any immediate mitigations.

ashley-engineer: seeing a sudden increase in average context length and kvcache hits since the v30.9 rollout ~ 10m ago. Prefill and long-history requests spiked. sample metric: kv_cache_entries_per_request went from 1.2 to 18.7 on avg.

mike-runtime: autoscaler shows pool config max_scale=4 and current nodes=4, queue length 11,200 requests. Scaling attempts are failing due to pool quota on this region (gpu.v100 quota consumed). logs: ``[autocaller] scale_up() -> quota_exceeded: region_quota=4``

sara-ml: v30.9 introduced a context hydration change that expands kv fanout for system prompts. We thought it would be fine but in large sessions it materializes as 3-5x more KV accesses. Rolling metrics show RTT and token cost spike.

dinesh-sre: customer impact: API error rate increased from 0.2% -> 4.6% for hosted customers using model alias "rwd-v30.9". Support ticket volume rising. We've marked severity: P0.

julia-support: CS flagged three enterprise customers experiencing 503s and increased tail latencies. They're seeing timeouts at 15s. Escalated to account teams.

ashley-engineer: immediate plan: roll back traffic for rwd-v30.9 to rwd-v30.8 using routing weight -> 0 within the router; enable fallback model rwd-stable-small for requests with context > 8k. Can someone take router change?

mike-runtime: I can flip the routing weight. Will do canary -> full rollback. Executing: ``curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/route/update -d '{"model":"rwd-v30.9","weight":0}'``. Pushing now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: route update started by mike-runtime at 2026-03-15T13:10:12Z.

mike-runtime: route change complete. Verification: traffic to rwd-v30.9 dropped to <1% in 2m. Queue depth down to 7,400 and still falling. Still seeing some slow prefill backpressure.

dinesh-sre: good. Next: reduce token window for long-running sessions and throttle prefill concurrency. I'm applying guardrails at the ingress: ``max_concurrent_prefill: 4`` and ``prefill_timeout_ms: 7000``. Applying now.

sara-ml: we should also turn off the new kv-prefetch flag introduced in v30.9 for the bluepool variant. Patch ready: ``kv_prefetch=false``. Who can push that?

ashley-engineer: I can push the runtime flag on dedicated pools. Pushing to eu-west-1 bluepool. Command: ``rbctl set-pool-flag bluepool kv_prefetch false``. Doing it.

ops-bot: ops-bot: pool flag change requested by ashley-engineer.

dinesh-sre: note: autoscaler quotas still block additional nodes. I opened a quota request to infra-quotas with high priority, but that will take 30+ minutes. We should avoid relying on immediate scale-up.

julia-support: Customer comms: draft pushed to the affected orgs. Suggested copy: "We're investigating increased latency and 503s; mitigations in progress. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause. No data exfiltration." Can someone OK and send?

eve-oncall: OK to send. Add note that rollback to v30.8 is in progress and we expect recovery in 10-20 minutes for most traffic.

mike-runtime: post-rollback metrics: queue depth 2,100, error rate falling back to 0.6%. Token latencies trending down. However we still have a hot tail for long sessions (sessions > 6k tokens) causing KV spikes.

ashley-engineer: mitigation summary: 1) rollback routing for v30.9 2) disable kv_prefetch flag 3) ingress prefill concurrency throttle 4) rate-limit large-context requests at gateway for hosted tier.

sara-ml: action item: create a patch to v30.9 that reworks the kv fanout to be capped per-session, and add a canary with lower default context. Will run thorough performance tests before re-deploy.

dinesh-sre: ops note: add autoscaler safety margin to avoid immediate exhaustion on future rollouts: set preferred_min_nodes = 2, target_buffer_ms = 3000, and publish a rollout checklist to verify kv metrics for any model change.

eve-oncall: I'm handing off to daytime oncall (ashley) in 25m. I'll remain available. Add to postmortem: impact window, affected customers, timeline, actions taken, and suggested safeguards.

julia-support: sent comms to affected customers (IDs: C-1209, C-2210, C-3310). They acknowledged and asked for a follow-up postmortem.

incident-bot: incident resolved: primary mitigations applied. Recovery observed at 13:31Z. Final status: degraded -> recovered. Incident will be auto-closed in 24h unless manually kept open. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/4987654320/postmortem

mike-runtime: adding temporary dashboard alerts for kv_cache_entries_per_request > 10 and fast autoscaler quota hits.

ashley-engineer: postmortem owners: sara-ml (root cause and fix), dinesh-sre (runbook + autoscaler policy), mike-runtime (deployment gating), julia-support (customer comms). We'll schedule a blameless review tomorrow 10am UTC.

eve-oncall: thanks everyone. Closing handoff now. If anything regresses ping me directly. :thumbsup:
